// The Playwright settings every suite in this course uses. A suite's own playwright.config.ts calls
// pantryConfig("./tests"). Tests share one shop and reset it, so they run one at a time.

import { join } from "node:path";
import { defineConfig } from "@playwright/test";

const ROOT = join(import.meta.dirname, "..");

export function pantryConfig(testDir: string) {
  const external = Boolean(process.env.BASE_URL);
  return defineConfig({
    testDir,
    testMatch: /.*\.spec\.ts$/,
    timeout: 15_000,
    expect: { timeout: 4_000 },
    workers: 1,
    fullyParallel: false,
    retries: 0,
    reporter: process.env.PW_JSON ? [["json", { outputFile: process.env.PW_JSON }]] : [["list"]],
    outputDir: process.env.PW_OUT ?? join(ROOT, ".runs", "test-results"),
    use: {
      // biome-ignore lint/style/useNamingConvention: baseURL is the name Playwright reads
      baseURL: process.env.BASE_URL ?? "http://localhost:4173",
      launchOptions: process.env.CHROMIUM_PATH ? { executablePath: process.env.CHROMIUM_PATH } : {},
      trace: "off",
      actionTimeout: 5_000,
      navigationTimeout: 10_000,
    },
    webServer: external
      ? undefined
      : {
          command: "bun world/cli.ts shop",
          cwd: ROOT,
          url: "http://localhost:4173/health",
          reuseExistingServer: true,
          timeout: 20_000,
        },
  });
}

content.text:
I wrote both test files and made the baselines. Then I ran both files twice more, and all 6 tests passed both times.

**`tests/visual.spec.ts`**
- The shop data is reset before each test.
- At 375 px and at 1280 px it takes two screenshots:
  - **The "Bananas, loose" card:** found by its role and name.
  - **The slot picker:** the test signs in as Ana first, because `/slots` only shows the picker to signed-in users. The screenshot covers only `#slot-form`, so the header is left out.
- The four baselines are in `tests/visual.spec.ts-snapshots/` (`bananas-card-{mobile,desktop}-linux.png` and `slot-picker-{mobile,desktop}-linux.png`). I opened them and they look right: at 375 px the price stays in its own row, and every slot has its label.

**`tests/a11y.spec.ts`**
- A `makeAxeBuilder` fixture sets up `AxeBuilder` with `wcag2a`, `wcag2aa`, `wcag21a` and `wcag21aa`, following the Playwright docs.
- It checks the whole shop page (`/`) and the slot picker (`#slot-form` on `/slots`, after signing in). Both expect `violations` to equal `[]`.
- No axe rules are turned off; none had to be. A comment in the fixture says where to turn one off and that it must name the ticket.

Results:
- **`--update-snapshots`:** 4 passed, 4 baselines written.
- **Both files, run 1:** 6 passed (4.5s).
- **Both files, run 2:** 6 passed (4.3s).

Two choices you may want changed:
- **Slot picker scan scope:** the axe scan of the slot picker covers only the form, not the rest of `/slots`. The rest of that page uses the same layout that the full shop-page scan already checks.
- **Platform suffix:** the baseline file names end in `-linux`, so they will only match when the tests run on Linux.
